title: Assistant: Eval Suite, Answer Feedback and Usage Analytics
summary: A versioned eval suite of scripted conversations, graded by rules and run with one command against the configured model, plus thumbs up/down feedback per answer and an `assistant.interaction` analytics event with a usage report (design doc Phase 4, first half).

acceptanceCriteria.text: At least 50 eval cases with ID, category, messages and pass rules, meeting per-category minimums (incl. 011 P1–P10, U1–U3, T034/T035 cases).
One command runs the suite on the running stack and configured model, each case in a new conversation as an eval user, data set up by the command.
Grading is rule-based and deterministic (tool names, text, handoff, proposal rules): same recorded reply, same grade.
Each run writes a report (per case, per category, overall, model, duration, tokens); non-zero exit when the target is missed.
2 consecutive runs on the configured model each reach ≥ 90% overall and 100% in safety categories.
The eval never runs in npm test/check; no automated test calls a model; grader and report unit-tested on recorded replies.
Finished answers show accessible thumbs up/down; changeable, last rating kept; hidden while streaming and on errors.
Feedback API: owner only; 401 without JWT, 404 for another user's conversation or unknown answer, 400 for an invalid rating.
Exactly one `assistant.interaction` event per finished turn with IDs, provider, model, outcome, tools, latency, tokens; no text, no user ID.
Each rating publishes one `assistant.feedback` event (IDs, rating, timestamp); no user ID, no text.
Both topics and payloads defined once in shared with parsers; contract test.
Analytics never slows or breaks chat: sent after streaming; Kafka down still finishes turns and saves ratings; failed events dropped with one log line.
Usage report per day and model (conversations, turns, tool calls, handoffs, mean/p95 latency, tokens, ratings) matches exactly after 10 turns + 3 ratings.
New logic unit-tested without Kafka, Redis or a model; each test seen failing once.
Changed services rebuilt and healthy; design doc, assistant README, testing strategy, architecture and README event flow updated.

openQuestions.text: One feature or two? Proposed: keep evals, feedback and analytics in 012, evals built first.
How many cases? Proposed: 50 to start, one more per bug found.
Pass target? Proposed: ≥ 90% overall, 100% in safety categories, on 2 consecutive runs.
How graded? Proposed: rules only (tools, events, proposals, key terms); no LLM judge.
One reply per case per run? Proposed: yes; 2 consecutive runs cover flakiness.
Eval data? Proposed: the command creates eval users and orders through the normal APIs.
No unasked handoff? Proposed: implicit 'no handoff event' rule on every non-handoff case.
Target model? Proposed: LM Studio qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-2507; works on Claude when credits exist.
Feedback content? Proposed: up/down only, changeable, no free text.
User ID in the interaction event? Proposed: none.
What reads analytics? Proposed: a CLI report from the topics; tokens only, no currency.
Per-user daily token budget now? Proposed: no, to the backlog.
